en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate museum room with a richly decorated stucco ceiling, polished floor, and glass display cases filled with mineral or geological specimens lining the walls. A long, low glass display case runs down the center of the room toward the back wall, where a bust on a pedestal stands between two large cabinets. Another bust on a pedestal is visible on the left wall. Printed caption text runs vertically along the right margin of the image.
